{{Top|leg}}
A '''plasma displacer''' was used by those individuals wishing to removed their [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]]. By patching it into the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and setting the [[cobulator]]s back a half pitch, the engine would run hot near the [[transponder director]], effectively distorting and masking the ship's transponder. While a ship close by would be able to read the transponder with a little difficult, it was almost impossible to read at a distance.
